request: User suggested PeriNorm and investigation of the transformer project as a model-change path.
name: peri-rms-lr2
single_change: Add parameter-free RMS normalization after the attention and SwiGLU output projections in every existing block.
hypothesis: Controlling residual branch output magnitudes may improve optimization; the frozen model has pre-branch RMS but no branch output RMS. This requires direct benchmark evidence.
source_scope: Use the branch update from Table 1 of Normalization in Attention Dynamics. The local Lean Scheme.peri and speedFactor describe idealized attention dynamics, not a guarantee of lower first-99 epochs for a trained GPT.
adaptation: Keep the repaired FP64 RMS backward, native dtype epsilon, all weights and RNG draws, unnormalized embedding, unit residual coefficients, Q/K RMS, XSA, RoPE, prefix guard and native AdamW LR x2. No learned gains, affine norm parameters, depth scaling or schedule change.
external_project_activity: Read-only source/paper/index inspection; the experiment runs in this authorized early99 benchmark, without modifying or launching the older transformer experiment queue.
screen_policy: Keep original budgets. Require 18/18 passes and improvement in at least three of the six per-task median paired epoch ratios versus LR x2 to advance. Preserve every screen row. No screen-only aggregate geometric mean is reported.
full_suite_policy: Evaluate all 75 paired short cells for every candidate that advances. Prefer complete coverage, then lower full-suite geometric-mean epochs. Compare against both original baseline and LR x2; include all per-task medians/worst cases, slower seeds and censoring. If no candidate improves on LR x2, retain the incumbent and report the negative results.
long_policy: Resolve both the cosine schedule and Peri-RMS short experiments before final selection. Run a new short winner on the already observed long regression suite once; never tune or reselect from long.
parameter_policy: No added trainable parameters; require exact matching initial parameter names, values and counts in every pair.
